Nimbus Labs - Leave Policy
HR-POL-001, version 3.2, effective 1 January 2026
1. Purpose and scope
This policy explains the types of leave available to permanent employees of Nimbus Labs in India,
how leave is accrued, and how to apply for it. Contractors and interns follow the terms in their
contracts.
2. Annual leave
Permanent employees are entitled to 24 days of annual (privilege) leave per calendar year, accrued
at 2 days per completed month of service. Employees in their first year receive leave pro rata from
their joining date. Annual leave is counted in working days; weekends and public holidays inside a
leave period are not deducted.
3. Carry forward and encashment
Up to 10 days of unused annual leave can be carried forward to the next calendar year. Any
balance above 10 days lapses on 31 December. Carried-forward leave must be used by 31 March

maximum of 30 days, calculated on basic salary.

4. Sick leave
Employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave per calendar year. Sick leave does not carry forward.
A medical certificate is required for sick leave of more than 2 consecutive working days. Sick leave
may be applied retrospectively within 7 days of returning to work.
5. Casual leave
Employees receive 6 days of casual leave per year for personal matters. Casual leave cannot be
combined with annual leave and may be taken for a maximum of 3 consecutive days.
6. Applying for leave
Leave is applied for through the HR portal or the HR Copilot, and is approved by the reporting
manager. Annual leave of more than 3 working days must be applied for at least 2 weeks in
advance. Requests are considered approved only after the manager approves them in the system.
Managers should respond to leave requests within 3 working days.

7. Parental leave
Birthing parents are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave, in line with the Maternity Benefit
Act. Non-birthing parents, including adoptive parents, are entitled to 4 weeks of paid paternity or
partner leave, to be taken within 6 months of the birth or adoption.
8. Other leave
Bereavement leave: up to 5 working days for the loss of an immediate family member. Marriage
leave: 5 working days, once during employment. Leave without pay may be granted for up to 3
months with HR business partner and department head approval.
9. Contact
Questions about this policy can be sent to hr-help@nimbuslabs.example or raised through the HR
Copilot.

Nimbus Labs - Hybrid and Remote Work Policy
HR-POL-004, version 2.0, effective 1 April 2026
1. Hybrid working model
Nimbus Labs follows a hybrid model. Employees are expected to work from their assigned office at
least 3 days per week, with Tuesday and Wednesday as common team days. Teams may agree on
the third day.
2. Fully remote work
Fully remote arrangements require approval from the department head and HR, and are reviewed
every 6 months. Employees may work remotely from another city in India for up to 4 weeks per year
with manager approval. Working from outside India requires prior approval from HR and Legal
because of tax and immigration rules.
3. Home office allowance
Employees receive a one-time home office allowance of INR 15,000 for furniture and accessories,
and an internet reimbursement of up to INR 1,500 per month, claimed through the expense portal
with receipts.

4. Equipment and security
Company laptops must be used for all work. Do not use public Wi-Fi without the company VPN.
Confidential documents must not be printed at home. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT
Security within 24 hours.
5. Working hours
Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 16:00 IST. Outside these hours employees can manage their
time flexibly, provided they meet their team commitments.

Nimbus Labs - Travel and Expense Policy
FIN-POL-007, version 5.1, effective 1 January 2026
1. Approvals
All business travel must be approved by the reporting manager before booking. International travel
also requires department head approval. Book travel through the corporate travel desk.
2. Flights and trains
Economy class is used for flights. Business class is allowed for flights longer than 8 hours. AC 2-tier
is allowed for train travel.
3. Hotels and daily allowance
Hotel limits per night: INR 7,000 in metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Chennai,
Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune) and INR 5,000 in other cities. The daily allowance for meals and local
travel is INR 2,000 in India. International per diems follow the country table published by Finance.

4. Submitting expenses
Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the travel end date with itemised receipts.
Receipts are required for any expense above INR 500. Claims are reimbursed in the next payroll
cycle after manager approval.
5. Non-reimbursable expenses
Alcohol, personal entertainment, traffic fines, minibar charges and upgrades not covered by this
policy are not reimbursable.
